rules.statement: Where a bank pays cheques under the mistaken belief that they are genuine, and the payee has acted in good faith on this belief by disposing of the money as instructed, the loss should not be shifted to the payee.
rules.supporting_quote: It cannot be said that he did anything which induced the belief that the cheques bore the genuine signature of D. S. P. Abeyewardene. These being the circumstances the plaintiff who has by his mistake sustained a loss should not in my judgment be permitted to shift that loss on to the defendant.

meta.parties: Imperial Bank of India v. Abeyesinghe
